name: worldping
description: World ping is an intelligent and ligh NODEJS script made to inform you about what's happening in the world with a quick popup on the bottom of your screen

scripts.build: npx esbuild index.js --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/bundle.js && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync(process.execPath, 'dist/WorldPing.exe')" && npx postject dist/WorldPing.exe NODE_SEA_BLOB sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2 && copyfiles -u 2 node_modules/node-notifier/vendor/**/* dist/ && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('worldping.ico', 'dist/worldping.ico')"

author: Blume Horizon
